legend: Bigfoot at Ape Canyon (Mount St. Helens, Washington, USA, July 1924)
lines: Five gold miners build a cabin near Mount Saint Helens.
Night after night, they hear strange whistles in the dark.
One evening, a huge, hairy figure steps out from between the pines.
A miner fires at it, and the creature runs away.
But at midnight, the whole cabin starts to shake.
Legend says giant creatures hurled rocks at the roof all night.
At dawn, the miners fled the mountain and never came back.
Skeptics call it a prank, but nobody can prove it.
Would you have stayed in that cabin?
title: The Bigfoot Attack at Ape Canyon: Rocks Rained on the Cabin #shorts
description:
In July 1924, five miners near Mount St. Helens said giant hairy creatures pelted their cabin with rocks all night. Hoax or something real in the woods?
